### A Good Name Is Important - The Crosswalk Devotional - June 25
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/a-good-name-is-important-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Proverbs 22:1
Points:
- A good name represents personal character, reputation, and integrity rather than material wealth.
- Choosing an honorable life reflects the holiness of God and draws others toward Him.
- Living with integrity establishes trust with others and provides enduring peace of mind.
- Earthly riches can disappear quickly, but a godly reputation leaves a lasting spiritual legacy.

### Remember Who You Are - Encouragement for Today - September 29, 2015
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/remember-who-you-are-encouragement-for-today-september-29-2015.html
Passage: Proverbs 22:1
Points:
- Daily choices shape character and establish the true value of a person's name.
- Remembering our identity as God’s children is far more precious than accumulating silver or gold.
- Bearing the Christian name carries the responsibility to model Christ's grace and purity.
- Pursuing an honorable name is a continuous journey of aligning actions with biblical truth.

### “What is that?” - Encouragement Café - November 7, 2014
Author: Jill Beran
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/what-is-that-encouragement-caf-november-7-2014.html
Passage: Proverbs 22:4
Points:
- Biblical humility is grounded in reverent awe and honor toward God.
- Humbling oneself requires acknowledging human limits while trusting what God says about our identity.
- True humility includes both quiet serving behind the scenes and stepping up in obedience.
- Living in the fear of the Lord yields true life, honor, and spiritual wealth.
